title: Keep Cargo out of the InterlockingRunner (Bun)

facts.note: Modules where an InterlockingRunner may be defined.
Requires parsing the module to see that it defines an InterlockingRunner (the production TrainRunner module is excluded).
Produced by the bun_interlocking_infrastructure family detector (checks/interlocking_no_cargo.mjs).

values: routing decision depends on mid-train Cargo state
facts.note: Semantic routing/variant-selection intent is not fully captured by the token detector.

fires: An InterlockingRunner module under src/trains/** references Cargo or assigns into a cargo mapping.
An InterlockingRunner caches artifact_urn -> artifact_data values or contains an artifact_urn string literal.
An InterlockingRunner chooses the next route from mid-train Cargo state.
Cargo contents are used to select a train variant.
doesNotFire: The production TrainRunner module constructs Cargo and passes it between wagons.
An InterlockingRunner reads the initial action/inputs/state before execution.
An InterlockingRunner reads a completed TrainResult at a declared route boundary.
A comment inside an InterlockingRunner module mentions Cargo (comments are masked).
A wagon module src/<wagon>/wagon.ts changes its imports (governed by the split convention coder.bun.wagon-does-not-import-interlocking).

given: A Bun module under src/trains/** that defines an InterlockingRunner (not the production TrainRunner module)
when: the module is created or changed
then: Keep Cargo inside TrainRunner execution: the InterlockingRunner must not reference, mutate, store (artifact_urn -> artifact_data) or route on Cargo.
prefer: InterlockingRunner reads only initial action/inputs/state before execution and a completed TrainResult at a declared route boundary.
Leave Cargo to TrainRunner, which passes it between wagons; wagons read and return artifact objects.
avoid: Cargo references or `cargo[...] = ...` in an InterlockingRunner module.
Storing artifact_urn -> artifact_data runtime values in the interlocking.
Routing on mid-train Cargo state; letting Cargo select train variants.
unless: The production TrainRunner module legitimately constructs and carries Cargo; it is not scanned for Cargo bleed.
why: Cargo is the artifact data plane carried by TrainRunner between wagons inside a selected train; the cargo_boundary keeps it inside that execution, so the interlocking never routes on mid-train Cargo state nor lets Cargo select train variants, routing only on initial inputs and declared-boundary TrainResults.
evidence: The bun_interlocking_infrastructure detector (checks/interlocking_no_cargo.mjs) reports no Cargo reference, cargo mapping mutation, or artifact_urn literal in any InterlockingRunner-defining module under src/trains/**.
The same detector reports no interlocking import in any src/<wagon>/wagon.ts (enforced via the split convention coder.bun.wagon-does-not-import-interlocking).
A reviewer confirms the InterlockingRunner's routing inputs are only the initial action/inputs/state and declared-boundary TrainResults, and that Cargo does not select train variants.
verifier_detail: Scan each InterlockingRunner-defining module under src/trains/** and flag: a `Cargo` reference, a `cargo[...] = ...` mutation, or an `artifact_urn` literal.

Scan each src/<wagon>/wagon.ts and flag an import of interlocking code (wagons must import their own dependencies, never InterlockingRunner) — the obligation of the split convention coder.bun.wagon-does-not-import-interlocking, enforced by the same detector.
Mask comments before matching; a string `artifact_urn` literal is still detected.
Exclude the production TrainRunner module from the Cargo-bleed scan; only InterlockingRunner-defining modules are scanned for Cargo bleed.

Which modules are scanned and how Cargo touches are recognized is the per-stack detector's concern; this detector is a member of the bun_interlocking_infrastructure FAMILY (checks/interlocking_no_cargo.mjs).
Severity 4, disposition strict (as authored in this rule): a newly introduced Cargo touch (or a wagon importing interlocking) is not suppressible and fails CI.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.1.0.
Bun-stack realization of the agnostic core obligation coder.train.interlocking-does-not-carry-cargo (core afokapu/atdd#1251); enforced by the JS detector in the atdd.workspace.bun implementation.
Summary: an agnostic "Cargo boundary" obligation rendered for the Bun application.
Core runtime spec afokapu/atdd#1251 — Cargo boundary.
Original name: Cargo stays inside TrainRunner execution; interlocking does not carry it and wagons stay clean (Bun).

Original statement also required: Bun wagons (src/<wagon>/wagon.ts) MUST NOT import interlocking code; forbidden list included 'wagons importing interlocking code'; fix_hint: 'Wagons import their own dependencies, never InterlockingRunner.' Carried operatively by split convention coder.bun.wagon-does-not-import-interlocking.

term cargo_boundary: the rule that Cargo (artifact data plane) stays inside TrainRunner execution; the InterlockingRunner must not reference/mutate Cargo or store artifact_urn values, and wagons must not import it.

splitSuggestion.then: A Bun wagon (src/<wagon>/wagon.ts) must not import InterlockingRunner or other interlocking code; it imports only its own dependencies.

facts.note: Produced by the bun_interlocking_infrastructure family detector (checks/interlocking_no_cargo.mjs).

fires: A src/<wagon>/wagon.ts is created or changed and imports InterlockingRunner or other interlocking code.
doesNotFire: A wagon imports only its own dependencies and reads/returns artifact objects.

avoid: Importing InterlockingRunner or other interlocking code from a wagon.
verifier_detail: Scan each src/<wagon>/wagon.ts and flag an import of interlocking code; strict, severity 4: a newly introduced wagon import of interlocking is not suppressible and fails CI.

sharedNodes.text: Strict disposition: a newly introduced violation is not suppressible and fails CI.

additions.text: The wagon-must-not-import-interlocking half of the cargo_boundary is split into its own operative convention coder.bun.wagon-does-not-import-interlocking with its own then, activation, avoid and verifier_detail; this rule's then is limited to the InterlockingRunner Cargo boundary.
additions.justification: Rule 2: one obligation per `then`; the wagon import prohibition is independently checkable on different files.

additions.text: Reviewer confirmation of routing inputs and that Cargo does not select train variants.
additions.justification: Mid-train Cargo routing and variant selection are not fully token-detectable; this makes the source's prohibitions checkable.
